mapper.select: SELECT v.vessel_id AS id, v.vessel_name AS name, v.latitude AS lat, v.longitude AS lng, v.status, IFNULL(g.group_id, 'NONE') AS groupId FROM TB_VESSEL v LEFT JOIN TB_USER_GROUP g ON v.vessel_id = g.vessel_id AND g.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT latitude AS lat, longitude AS lng, recorded_time AS recordedTime FROM TB_VESSEL_HISTORY WHERE vessel_id = #{vesselId} ORDER BY recorded_time ASC
SELECT alarm_type AS type, message, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time FROM tb_alarm WHERE vessel_id = #{vesselId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
